'''Ivan Igorevich Zatevakhin''' ({{langx|ru|Ива́н И́горевич Затева́хин}}; born September 7, 1959, Moscow) is a Russian television and radio host, [[Kandidat nauk|candidate of biological sciences]] (1988).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://tricolortvmag.ru/article/canals/zhivye-istorii/|title=Иван Затевахин взялся за своё: канал «Россия 1» запускает новое шоу о животных|publisher=Триколор ТВ|date=2017-01-17}}</ref> He is best known as the author and presenter of the popular science program ''[[:ru:Диалоги о животных|Dialogues about Animals]]'' on the TV channel [[Russia 1]].<ref>[http://kp.ru/daily/25758.4/2743188/ Иван Затевахин: «В Корее едят собак, но животных всё равно любят»]</ref><ref>[http://www.kommersant.ru/doc/217323 Ъ-Газета — Финалисты ТЭФИ-99<!-- Заголовок добавлен ботом -->]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://tvp.netcollect.ru/tvps/zvmkpddcjron.pdf|title=Иван Затевахин был когда-то «плохим дядькой» в телогрейке|website=[[Российская газета]]|date=2004-02-13}}</ref>  Four-time nominee for [[TEFI]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20111105024655/http://www.spr.ru/begovoy/dialogi-o-zhivotnih.html Диалоги о животных]</ref>

==Biography==
He was born on September 7, 1959, in Moscow in a family of doctors.

His father, Igor Zatevakhin (born 1936), is an academician of the Russian Academy of Medical Sciences, professor, doctor of medical sciences. His mother, Marina Zatevakhina, is an anesthesiologist, an employee of the Scientific Center for Cardiovascular Surgery. His paternal grandfather, [[Ivan Zatevakhin]], is a lieutenant general, former commander of the USSR Airborne Forces.
